```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
require("knitr")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
set.seed(123)
```

```{r load_libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(here)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(scales)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

library(ggupset)
library(patchwork)
combined_pairs = read_csv(here("results/combined_kinase_substrate_pairs_2025.csv")) %>%
  # The released table labels the atlas layer "Cantley"; show it under the name the
  # manuscript uses so the portal and the paper agree.
  mutate(Source = if_else(Source == "Cantley", "Specificity Atlas", Source))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
curated_sources <- c("PhosphoSitePlus","EPSD","iPTMNet","PhosphoELM","PhosphoNetworks")

# Per-site detail, kept alongside the collapsed edge table so the portal can
# answer "which site on this substrate does this kinase hit?" -- the case where a
# kinase is known to phosphorylate a protein but the residue is unidentified.
site_tbl <- combined_pairs %>%
  mutate(evidence = if_else(Source %in% curated_sources, "Curated", "Predicted")) %>%
  group_by(Kinase, Substrate, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    evidence           = if_else(any(evidence == "Curated"), "Curated", "Predicted"),
    Uniprot            = dplyr::first(na.omit(Substrate_Uniprot_ID)),
    CuratedSite        = any(Curated_site),
    LikelyFunctional   = any(Likely_functional),
    MotifPercentile    = suppressWarnings(max(Motif_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MotifRank          = suppressWarnings(min(Motif_rank, na.rm = TRUE)),
    FunctionalScore    = suppressWarnings(max(Functional_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    SharedCompartments = suppressWarnings(max(Shared_compartments, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Score              = suppressWarnings(max(KinaseCanvas_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    # +/-7 residues around the phosphoacceptor, canonical-sequence-verified in
    # the main pipeline; NA where verification failed (see the pipeline's
    # "Flanking sequence" step) rather than showing an unverified guess.
    FlankingSequence   = dplyr::first(na.omit(Flanking_sequence)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(MotifPercentile, MotifRank, FunctionalScore,
                  SharedCompartments, Score),
                ~ if_else(is.finite(.x), round(.x, 3), NA_real_)))

edge_tbl <- combined_pairs %>%
  mutate(evidence = if_else(Source %in% curated_sources, "Curated", "Predicted")) %>%
  group_by(Kinase, Substrate) %>%
  summarise(
    evidence      = if_else(any(evidence == "Curated"), "Curated", "Predicted"),
    Likely_functional = any(Likely_functional),
    SiteCount     = n_distinct(Site),
    Sites         = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Site))), collapse = "; "),
    Uniprot       = dplyr::first(na.omit(Substrate_Uniprot_ID)),
    MotifPercentile    = suppressWarnings(max(Motif_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MotifRank          = suppressWarnings(min(Motif_rank, na.rm = TRUE)),
    FunctionalScore    = suppressWarnings(max(Functional_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    SharedCompartments = suppressWarnings(max(Shared_compartments, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Score              = suppressWarnings(max(KinaseCanvas_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Reference_PMID = paste(sort(unique(Reference_PMID[!is.na(Reference_PMID) & Reference_PMID != ""])), collapse = "; "),
    Sources       = paste(sort(unique(Source)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(MotifPercentile, MotifRank, FunctionalScore,
                  SharedCompartments, Score),
                ~ if_else(is.finite(.x), round(.x, 3), NA_real_))) %>%
  transmute(
    source = Kinase,
    target = Substrate,
    evidence,
    Likely_functional,
    SiteCount,
    Sites,
    Uniprot,
    MotifPercentile,
    MotifRank,
    FunctionalScore,
    SharedCompartments,
    Score,
    Reference_PMID,
    edgeLabel = paste0(evidence, ifelse(Likely_functional, " · functional", "")),
    SourceList = Sources
  ) %>%
  mutate(Likely_functional = if_else(Likely_functional, "Likely functional", "Other/Unknown"))

node_tbl <- bind_rows(
  combined_pairs %>% transmute(Gene = Kinase,    Entrez = Kinase_entrez, role = "Kinase"),
  combined_pairs %>% transmute(Gene = Substrate, Entrez = Substrate_entrez, role = "Substrate")
) %>%
  mutate(Entrez = if_else(is.na(Entrez) | Entrez == "", NA_integer_, Entrez)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Entrez = dplyr::first(na.omit(Entrez)),
    role   = paste(sort(unique(role)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gene)

deg_tbl <- edge_tbl %>%
  count(source, name = "outdeg") %>%
  full_join(edge_tbl %>% count(target, name = "indeg"), by = c("source" = "target")) %>%
  mutate(outdeg = coalesce(outdeg, 0L), indeg  = coalesce(indeg, 0L)) %>%
  transmute(Gene = source, outdeg, indeg) %>%
  distinct()

#add uniprot ID to node_tbl (convert from entrezid) and dedupe many-to-one mappings
node_uniprot <- bitr(node_tbl$Entrez, fromType="ENTREZID", toType="UNIPROT", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db") %>%
  distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

node_tbl <- node_tbl %>%
  left_join(deg_tbl, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(Entrez = as.character(Entrez)) %>%
  left_join(node_uniprot, by = c("Entrez" = "ENTREZID")) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Entrez, role) %>%
  summarise(
    outdeg = max(coalesce(outdeg, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    indeg  = max(coalesce(indeg, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    UNIPROT = dplyr::first(na.omit(UNIPROT)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nodes_json <- node_tbl %>%
  transmute(data = pmap(list(id = Gene, label = Gene, Entrez = Entrez, role = role,
                             indeg = indeg, outdeg = outdeg, deg = indeg + outdeg, uniprot = UNIPROT),
                        ~ list(id = ..1, label = ..2, Entrez = ..3, role = ..4,
                               indeg = ..5, outdeg = ..6, deg = ..7, uniprot = ..8))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(data)

edges_json <- edge_tbl %>%
  transmute(data = pmap(
    list(source, target, evidence, Likely_functional, SiteCount, Sites, Uniprot,
         MotifPercentile, MotifRank, FunctionalScore, SharedCompartments, Score,
         Reference_PMID, edgeLabel, SourceList),
    ~ list(source = ..1, target = ..2,
           evidence = ..3,
           Likely_functional = ..4,
           SiteCount = ..5,
           Sites = ..6,
           Uniprot = ..7,
           MotifPercentile = ..8,
           MotifRank = ..9,
           FunctionalScore = ..10,
           SharedCompartments = ..11,
           Score = ..12,
           Reference_PMID = ..13,
           edgeLabel = ..14,
           SourceList = ..15))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(data)

sites_json <- site_tbl %>%
  transmute(data = pmap(
    list(Kinase, Substrate, Site, Uniprot, evidence, CuratedSite, LikelyFunctional,
         MotifPercentile, MotifRank, FunctionalScore, SharedCompartments, Score,
         FlankingSequence),
    ~ list(kinase = ..1, substrate = ..2, site = ..3, uniprot = ..4,
           evidence = ..5, curatedSite = ..6, likelyFunctional = ..7,
           motifPercentile = ..8, motifRank = ..9, functionalScore = ..10,
           sharedCompartments = ..11, score = ..12, flankingSequence = ..13))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(data)

payload <- list(nodes = nodes_json, edges = edges_json)

json_payload <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)
json_sites   <- jsonlite::toJSON(sites_json, auto_unbox = TRUE)
json_kinases <- jsonlite::toJSON(sort(node_tbl$Gene[grepl("Kinase", node_tbl$role, fixed = TRUE)]), auto_unbox = TRUE)
json_subs    <- jsonlite::toJSON(sort(node_tbl$Gene[grepl("Substrate", node_tbl$role, fixed = TRUE)]), auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r}
data_tags <- tagList(
  tags$script(id = "ks-data",  type = "application/json", HTML(json_payload)),
  tags$script(id = "kin-data", type = "application/json", HTML(json_kinases)),
  tags$script(id = "sub-data", type = "application/json", HTML(json_subs)),
  tags$script(id = "site-data", type = "application/json", HTML(json_sites))
)

viewer_tags <- tags$div(
  `data-quarto-disable-processing` = "true",

  tags$style(HTML("
    :root {
      --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
      --bg: #f5f1e6;
      --panel: #f0ece2;
      --panel-2: #e8e3d8;
      --ink: #1f1b16;
      --muted: #5b564c;
      --accent: #1f1b16;
      --accent-2: #4b4336;
      --stroke: rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
      --radius-sm: 3px;
      --radius-md: 5px;
    }
    /* Quarto Overrides */
    .quarto-container, .quarto-page-container, .main, .quarto-content-column { max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important; }
    /* page-layout:full still seats <main> in Quarto's 'page' column (~1135px on any screen),
       which left the network canvas ~450px wide. Span the whole screen track instead, and
       line the title block up with the app's left edge. */
    main#quarto-document-content, #title-block-header{grid-column:screen-start-inset / screen-end-inset !important}
    #title-block-header{max-width:2400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
    #title-block-header h1.title{font-size:1.5rem;margin:10px 0 2px}
    #title-block-header .quarto-title-meta{margin-top:0;padding-bottom:0}
    #title-block-header .quarto-title-meta-heading{font-size:10px}
    #title-block-header .quarto-title-meta-contents p{margin:0;font-size:12px}
    body {font-family: var(--font-sans); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-size:14px;}
    .page-shell{max-width:2400px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 18px 32px;}
    header#topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 20px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--radius-md);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10}
    #brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:0.2px;color:var(--ink)}
    #brand .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-2)}
    #statLine{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--font-mono)}
    nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;margin-left:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:1px solid transparent}
    nav a:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--stroke);background:var(--panel-2)}

    /* Quarto's page-layout:full mode injects 'page-columns page-full' onto every
       nested div for its own margin-note grid system, and its combined-class
       selector outranks our single-class .app-grid rule for grid-template-columns.
       !important, plus explicit column placement on each child below, makes our
       three-column layout win regardless of what Quarto adds. */
    .app-grid{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:240px minmax(0,1fr) 370px !important;gap:16px;align-items:start}
    @media (min-width: 1101px){
      .app-grid.controls-hidden{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 370px !important}
      .app-grid.controls-hidden #sidebar{display:none}
      .app-grid.controls-hidden #main-col{grid-column:1}
      .app-grid.controls-hidden #detailPanel{grid-column:2}
    }
    /* Narrow screens: a single column in the order a user works through it -- search inputs,
       the graph they drive, its details, then the remaining controls, then the table. The
       sidebar and main column are flattened (display:contents) so their parts can be ordered
       individually; the sidebar's groups become their own cards. */
    @media (max-width: 1100px){
      .app-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) !important}
      /* .app-grid prefix: the desktop #sidebar/#detailPanel rules come later and would win on equal specificity */
      .app-grid #sidebar, .app-grid #main-col{display:contents}
      .app-grid > *, .app-grid #sidebar > *, .app-grid #main-col > *{grid-column:1 !important;min-width:0}
      .app-grid .sidebar-intro{order:1} .app-grid .search-group{order:2} .app-grid #network{order:3} .app-grid #detailPanel{order:4}
      .app-grid #sidebar > .sidebar-group:not(.search-group), .app-grid #sidebar > .tip{order:5}
      .app-grid #table{order:6}
      .app-grid #sidebar > .sidebar-group{border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px}
      .app-grid #detailPanel{position:static;max-height:none}
      #btnControls{display:none}
    }
    /* Phones: the neighbourhood graph is roughly round, so a square canvas avoids a screenful of
       empty space (the .app-grid prefix is needed to beat the base #cy height defined below). */
    /* ...and the header wraps to ~140px there, so it scrolls away instead of pinning over the content. */
    @media (max-width: 640px){.app-grid #cy{height:auto;aspect-ratio:1 / 1} header#topbar{position:static}}

    #sidebar{grid-column:1;border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;position:sticky;top:70px;max-height:calc(100vh - 90px);overflow:auto}
    #main-col{grid-column:2;min-width:0}
    .sidebar-intro{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
    .sidebar-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--stroke)}
    .sidebar-group:first-of-type{border-top:none;padding-top:0}
    .sidebar-group h4{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
    .field-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
    .field-row label{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
    .check-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;font-size:13px}
    .check-row input{margin-top:3px}

    .section-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 10px}
    .section-head h3{margin:0;font-size:15px}
    .panel{border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:12px}

    #legend, #nodeLegend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
    #legend .chip, #nodeLegend .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel-2)}
    #legend .line{width:28px;height:0;border-top:3px solid #999}
    #legend .line.known{border-color:#1f1b16}
    #legend .line.novel{border-color:#5f564c}
    .legend-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:0}
    /* Swatches mirror the node selectors in the Cytoscape stylesheet below --
       shape and colour both encode role, so keep these two definitions in sync.
       The hexagon is an inline SVG rather than a clipped div: clip-path crops a
       CSS border along with the box, so only the flat edges keep a border and
       the diagonals are left bare -- an SVG stroke follows the actual outline. */
    .shape-swatch{flex:none;width:14px;height:14px;box-sizing:border-box}
    .shape-swatch.sub{border-radius:3px;background:#e1d7c7;border:1.5px solid #6a5c4a}
    .shape-swatch.both{width:12px;height:12px;background:#f2e6cf;border:1.5px solid #2a241b;transform:rotate(45deg)}

    #truncNote{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;min-height:1em}
    #cywrap{margin-bottom:12px}
    #cy {width:100%;height:clamp(520px, calc(100vh - 240px), 1100px);border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:#f7f2e8}

    .badge {display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:1px solid var(--stroke);color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel-2);font-size:11px;font-family:var(--font-mono)}
    .kbadge{background:#f4efe4;border-color:#3b352c;color:#1f1b16}
    .sbadge{background:#e9e2d6;border-color:#4a4339;color:#1f1b16}

    .filters {display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0}
    .filters input {padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:12px;background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink)}
    .filters input:focus{outline:1px solid var(--accent)}
    .tablebox {max-height:400px; overflow:auto; border:1px solid var(--stroke); border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--panel-2)}
    .tbl {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}
    .tbl th, .tbl td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke);padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
    .tbl td.num{font-family:var(--font-mono)}
    .tbl th{background:var(--panel); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; color:var(--muted)}

    .btn.sm{padding:3px 9px;font-size:12px}
    .btn{display:inline-block;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;font-family:var(--font-sans)}
    .btn:hover{background:var(--panel-2)}
    .btn.primary{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
    .btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-2)}
    .btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}

    .tip{margin:0;border:1px dashed var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}

    select, input[type='checkbox'], input[list], input[type='text'], input[type='range']{font-family:var(--font-sans)}
    select, input[list]{background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:6px 8px;font-size:13px;width:100%}

    #detailPanel{grid-column:3;border:1px solid var(--stroke);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px;font-size:13px;position:sticky;top:70px;max-height:calc(100vh - 90px);overflow:auto}
    #detailPanel h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px}
    .detail-role{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.4px;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--stroke);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:2px 6px;margin-bottom:8px}
    .detail-link{font-size:12px}
    .detail-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:12px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke)}
    .detail-row .k{color:var(--muted)}
    .detail-row .v{font-family:var(--font-mono)}
    .detail-pmids{font-size:12px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke)}
    .detail-pmids .k{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
    .detail-pmids .v{font-family:var(--font-mono);line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
    .pmid-more summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
    .pmid-scroll{max-height:160px;overflow:auto;margin-top:4px}
    .detail-sites{margin-top:10px}
    /* The sites table (7 columns including a 15-character sequence) is wider
       than the 300px detail panel; scroll it horizontally rather than letting
       it clip or force the whole panel wider. */
    .detail-sites .table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:4px}
    .detail-sites table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
    .detail-sites th,.detail-sites td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--stroke);padding:3px 4px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
    .detail-sites th.num,.detail-sites td.num{font-family:var(--font-mono)}
    .detail-interactions{list-style:none;margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
    .detail-interactions li{font-size:12px}
    .detail-jump{background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font-sans)}
  ")),

  tags$div(
    class="page-shell",
    tags$header(id="topbar",
      tags$div(id="brand", tags$span(class="dot"), "KinaseCanvas Explorer"),
      tags$div(id="statLine"),
      tags$nav(
        tags$a(href="#network", "Network"),
        tags$a(href="#table", "Edges"),
        tags$a(href="https://github.com/cujoisa/KinaseCanvas", target="_blank", rel="noopener", "GitHub"),
        tags$a(href="https://kinet.kinametrix.com/#section-proteins", target="_blank", "KiNet (curated resource)")
      )
    ),

    tags$div(class="app-grid",

      tags$div(id="sidebar",
        tags$p(class="sidebar-intro", "Search a kinase or substrate to explore curated and predicted interactions."),

        tags$div(class="sidebar-group search-group",
          tags$h4("Search"),
          tags$div(class="field-row",
            tags$label(`for`="kinSel", "Kinase"),
            tags$input(id="kinSel", list="kinList", placeholder="Type a kinase…"),
            tags$datalist(id="kinList")
          ),
          tags$div(class="field-row",
            tags$label(`for`="subSel", "Substrate"),
            tags$input(id="subSel", list="subList", placeholder="Type a substrate…"),
            tags$datalist(id="subList")
          ),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="pairModeChk"),
                     "Pair mode (show only this kinase–substrate link)")
        ),

        tags$div(class="sidebar-group",
          tags$h4("Filters"),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="curatedOnlyChk"), "Curated pairs only"),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="onlyFunctionalChk"), "Functional sites only"),
          tags$div(class="field-row",
            tags$label(`for`="scoreMin", "Min. confidence"),
            tags$input(type="range", id="scoreMin", min="0", max="100", value="0", step="5"),
            tags$span(id="scoreMinVal", class="badge", "0.00"),
            tags$span(class="legend-note", "Filters predicted edges by composite score; curated edges are always kept.")
          )
        ),

        tags$div(class="sidebar-group",
          tags$h4("Display"),
          tags$div(class="field-row",
            tags$label(`for`="layoutSel", "Layout"),
            tags$select(
              id="layoutSel",
              tags$option(value="fcose","fCoSE"),
              tags$option(value="cose","COSE"),
              tags$option(value="cose-bilkent","CoSE-Bilkent"),
              tags$option(value="concentric","Concentric"),
              tags$option(value="breadthfirst","Breadthfirst")
            )
          ),
          tags$div(class="field-row",
            tags$label(`for`="labelScale", "Label size"),
            tags$input(type="range", id="labelScale", min="50", max="180", value="100", step="10"),
            tags$span(id="labelScaleVal", class="badge", "100%")
          ),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="edgeLabelsChk"), "Edge labels"),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="arrowsChk", checked=NA), "Arrows"),
          tags$label(class="check-row", tags$input(type="checkbox", id="showAllChk"), "Show all substrates (no cap)")
        ),

        tags$div(class="sidebar-group",
          tags$h4("Legend"),
          tags$div(id="nodeLegend",
            tags$span(class="chip",
                      HTML('<svg class="shape-swatch kin" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><polygon points="5,0 15,0 20,10 15,20 5,20 0,10" fill="#fbf6ec" stroke="#2a241b" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>'),
                      "Kinase"),
            tags$span(class="chip", tags$span(class="shape-swatch sub"), "Substrate"),
            tags$span(class="chip", tags$span(class="shape-swatch both"), "Both")
          ),
          tags$div(id="legend",
            tags$span(class="chip", tags$span(class="line known"), "Curated"),
            tags$span(class="chip", tags$span(class="line novel"), "Predicted")
          ),
          tags$p(class="legend-note", "Dotted = not flagged functional; solid = likely functional. For predicted edges, thickness and opacity scale with the composite confidence score.")
        ),

        tags$div(class="sidebar-group",
          tags$h4("Export"),
          tags$div(class="btn-row",
            tags$button(id="btnPng", class="btn primary", "PNG"),
            tags$button(id="btnPdf", class="btn", "PDF"),
            tags$button(id="btnCsvEdges", class="btn", "Edge CSV"),
            tags$button(id="btnCsvSites", class="btn", "Site CSV"),
            tags$button(id="btnFullNetwork", class="btn", "Full network")
          )
        ),

        tags$p(class="tip", "Drag nodes to reposition. Scroll to zoom. Click a node or edge for details.")
      ),

      tags$div(id="main-col",
        tags$div(id="network", class="section",
          tags$div(class="section-head", tags$h3("Network"),
            tags$button(id="btnControls", type="button", class="btn sm", "Hide controls")),
          tags$div(id="truncNote"),
          tags$div(id="cywrap", tags$div(id="cy"))
        ),

        tags$div(id="table", class="section",
          tags$div(class="section-head", tags$h3("Edges in View")),
          tags$div(class="panel",
            tags$div(id="edgesFilters", class="filters"),
            tags$div(id="edgesTable", class="tablebox")
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$div(id="detailPanel",
        tags$h4("Details"),
        tags$div(id="detailBody",
          tags$p(id="detailPlaceholder", "Click a node or edge to see details.")
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  tags$script(src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.26.0/dist/cytoscape.min.js"),
  tags$script(src="https://unpkg.com/layout-base/layout-base.js"),
  tags$script(src="https://unpkg.com/cose-base/cose-base.js"),
  tags$script(src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape-fcose@2.2.0/cytoscape-fcose.js"),
  tags$script(src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape-cose-bilkent@4.1.0/cytoscape-cose-bilkent.js"),
  tags$script(src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js"),

  tags$script(HTML("
  (function(){
    const data       = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('ks-data').textContent);
    const kinases    = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('kin-data').textContent);
    const substrates = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sub-data').textContent);
    const siteData   = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('site-data').textContent);

    // Largest neighbourhood rendered before truncation kicks in. Chosen so the
    // median kinase (41 substrates) is never truncated while the hubs are.
    const NEIGHBOURHOOD_CAP = 75;
    let lastTruncation = {shown: 0, total: 0, hidden: 0};
    let currentSeeds = [];
    const maxDeg     = data.nodes.reduce((m,n) => Math.max(m, (n.indeg || 0) + (n.outdeg || 0)), 0);

    const stats = {
      kinases: kinases.length,
      substrates: substrates.length,
      edges: data.edges.length,
      curated: data.edges.filter(e => e.evidence === 'Curated').length
    };
    const statLineEl = document.getElementById('statLine');
    if(statLineEl){
      const pctCurated = stats.edges ? Math.round((stats.curated / stats.edges) * 100) : 0;
      statLineEl.textContent = stats.kinases.toLocaleString() + ' kinases · ' +
        stats.substrates.toLocaleString() + ' substrates · ' +
        stats.edges.toLocaleString() + ' interactions · ' +
        pctCurated + '% curated';
    }

    const kinDL = document.getElementById('kinList');
    kinases.forEach(g => { const opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.value = g; kinDL.appendChild(opt); });
    const subDL = document.getElementById('subList');
    substrates.forEach(g => { const opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.value = g; subDL.appendChild(opt); });
    const kinInput = document.getElementById('kinSel');
    const subInput = document.getElementById('subSel');
    kinInput.placeholder = 'Type a kinase…';
    subInput.placeholder = 'Type a substrate…';
    // Seed with a kinase on first load so the page isn't blank; TNIK is a good
    // demo case (moderate degree, mix of curated and predicted substrates). The
    // field is still just a normal search box -- clearing it and typing a
    // substrate works exactly as it would from a blank start.
    kinInput.value = 'TNIK';

    const labelScale   = document.getElementById('labelScale');
    const labelScaleEl = document.getElementById('labelScaleVal');
    const baseFont     = 12;
    const basePad      = 10;

    const cy = cytoscape({
      container: document.getElementById('cy'),
      elements: [],
      style: [
        { selector: 'node',
          style: {
            'shape': 'round-rectangle',
            'background-color': '#f6f1e7',
            'label': 'data(label)',
            'font-size': 10,
            'color': '#1f1b16',
            'text-opacity': 1,
            'text-wrap': 'wrap',
            'text-max-width': '130px',
            'min-zoomed-font-size': 6,
            'text-margin-y': -2,
            'text-halign': 'center',
            'text-valign': 'center',
            'border-color': '#2f281e',
            'border-width': 0.9,
            'width': 'label',
            'height': 'label',
            'padding': '4px'
          }
        },
        // Shape as well as colour encodes role, so the three classes stay
        // distinguishable in greyscale and for colour-vision-deficient readers.
        { selector: 'node[role *= \"Substrate\"]:not([role *= \"Kinase\"])',
          style: { 'shape': 'round-rectangle',
                   'background-color': '#e1d7c7', 'border-color': '#6a5c4a' } },
        { selector: 'node[role *= \"Kinase\"]:not([role *= \"Substrate\"])',
          style: { 'shape': 'round-hexagon',
                   'background-color': '#fbf6ec', 'border-color': '#2a241b' } },
        { selector: 'node[role *= \"Kinase\"][role *= \"Substrate\"]',
          style: { 'shape': 'round-diamond',
                   'background-color': '#f2e6cf', 'border-color': '#2a241b' } },
        { selector: 'node.qk', style: { 'border-width': 2.5 } },
        { selector: 'node.qs', style: { 'border-width': 2.5 } },
        { selector: 'edge',
          style: {
            'width': 1.6,
            'curve-style': 'bezier',
            'line-color': '#4f4a42',
            'target-arrow-color': '#4f4a42',
            'target-arrow-shape': 'triangle',
            'label': 'data(edgeLabel)',
            'font-size': 9,
            'text-rotation': 'autorotate',
            'text-background-color': '#ffffff',
            'text-background-opacity': 0.85,
            'text-background-padding': 2,
            'text-margin-y': -2
          }
        },
        { selector: 'edge[evidence = \"Curated\"]',
          style: { 'line-color': '#16110c', 'target-arrow-color': '#16110c' } },
        { selector: 'edge[evidence = \"Predicted\"]',
          style: { 'line-color': '#7b6d5d', 'target-arrow-color': '#7b6d5d' } },
        // Predicted edges are drawn in proportion to their composite confidence
        // score, so relative strength is visible rather than only filterable.
        { selector: 'edge[evidence = \"Predicted\"][Score]',
          style: { 'width': 'mapData(Score, 0, 1, 0.8, 4.5)',
                   'opacity': 'mapData(Score, 0, 1, 0.45, 1)' } },
        { selector: 'edge[Likely_functional = \"Likely functional\"]',
          style: { 'line-style': 'solid' } },
        { selector: 'edge[Likely_functional = \"Other/Unknown\"]',
          style: { 'line-style': 'dotted' } }
      ],
      layout: { name: 'fcose' }
    });

    // Ranks a kinase-substrate interaction for both the neighbourhood-cap
    // truncation (incidentSubgraph) and the node-detail top-interactions list:
    // curated first (direct experimental evidence, no composite score), then
    // predicted by descending confidence, ties broken alphabetically so ordering
    // is stable across renders.
    function edgeRankCompare(a, b){
      const ac = a.evidence === 'Curated', bc = b.evidence === 'Curated';
      if(ac !== bc) return ac ? -1 : 1;
      const as = (a.Score == null) ? -1 : Number(a.Score);
      const bs = (b.Score == null) ? -1 : Number(b.Score);
      if(as !== bs) return bs - as;
      return (a.source + a.target).localeCompare(b.source + b.target);
    }

    function escHtml(v){
      return String(v ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    }

    function uniprotLink(acc, label){
      if(!acc) return escHtml(label || '');
      const url = 'https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/' + encodeURIComponent(acc);
      return '<a class=\\'detail-link\\' href=\\'' + url + '\\' target=\\'_blank\\' rel=\\'noopener\\'>' +
             escHtml(label || acc) + ' (UniProt)</a>';
    }

    // PMIDs are stored as one '; '-separated string per pair. The median pair has 6, but the
    // busiest (PDPK1 -> AKT1) has over a thousand, so link the first few (oldest first, i.e. the
    // original characterisation papers) and fold the remainder into a scrollable list.
    const PMID_SHOWN = 8;
    function pmidLink(id){
      return '<a class=\\'detail-link\\' href=\\'https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/' + encodeURIComponent(id) +
             '/\\' target=\\'_blank\\' rel=\\'noopener\\'>' + escHtml(id) + '</a>';
    }

    function pmidRow(str){
      const ids = Array.from(new Set(String(str ?? '').split(';').map(x => x.trim()).filter(x => /^[0-9]+$/.test(x))))
                       .sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
      if(!ids.length) return '';
      let html = '<div class=\\'detail-pmids\\'><span class=\\'k\\'>PMIDs for curated sites (' + ids.length + ')</span><div class=\\'v\\'>' +
                 ids.slice(0, PMID_SHOWN).map(pmidLink).join(', ');
      if(ids.length > PMID_SHOWN){
        html += '<details class=\\'pmid-more\\'><summary>+' + (ids.length - PMID_SHOWN) + ' more</summary>' +
                '<div class=\\'pmid-scroll\\'>' + ids.slice(PMID_SHOWN).map(pmidLink).join(', ') + '</div></details>';
      }
      return html + '</div></div>';
    }

    function detailRow(k, v){
      return '<div class=\\'detail-row\\'><span class=\\'k\\'>' + escHtml(k) +
             '</span><span class=\\'v\\'>' + escHtml(v) + '</span></div>';
    }

    // Flanking sequences are stored as e.g. 'DGTEIAV[S]PRSLHSE', with the
    // phosphoacceptor bracketed by the pipeline once it has verified the
    // residue against the canonical UniProt sequence. Sites that failed
    // verification carry no flanking sequence at all (see the pipeline's
    // 'Flanking sequence' step) rather than showing an unverified guess.
    function renderFlank(flank){
      if(!flank) return '<span class=\\'legend-note\\'>not verified against canonical sequence</span>';
      const m = /^(.*)\\[(.)\\](.*)$/.exec(flank);
      if(!m) return '<span class=\\'v\\'>' + escHtml(flank) + '</span>';
      return '<span class=\\'v\\'>' + escHtml(m[1]) + '<strong>' + escHtml(m[2]) +
             '</strong>' + escHtml(m[3]) + '</span>';
    }

    function renderDetailPanel(html){
      const body = document.getElementById('detailBody');
      if(body){ body.innerHTML = html; }
    }
    function clearDetailPanel(){
      renderDetailPanel('<p id=\\'detailPlaceholder\\'>Click a node or edge to see details.</p>');
    }

    function showNodeDetail(node){
      const d = node.data();
      const role = d.role || '';
      const isK = role.indexOf('Kinase') >= 0, isS = role.indexOf('Substrate') >= 0;
      const roleLabel = (isK && isS) ? 'Kinase and substrate' : isK ? 'Kinase' : 'Substrate';
      const outN = node.outgoers('node').length;
      const inN  = node.incomers('node').length;
      const relatedEdges = data.edges
        .filter(e => e.source === d.id || e.target === d.id)
        .slice().sort(edgeRankCompare).slice(0, 5);

      let html = '<span class=\\'detail-role\\'>' + escHtml(roleLabel) + '</span>';
      html += '<h4>' + escHtml(d.label) + '</h4>';
      if(d.uniprot){ html += '<p>' + uniprotLink(d.uniprot, d.label) + '</p>'; }
      if(isK){ html += detailRow('Substrates', outN); }
      if(isS){ html += detailRow('Upstream kinases', inN); }
      if(relatedEdges.length){
        html += '<div class=\\'detail-sites\\'><strong>Top interactions</strong><ul class=\\'detail-interactions\\'>';
        relatedEdges.forEach(e => {
          const other = (e.source === d.id) ? e.target : e.source;
          const dir   = (e.source === d.id) ? ' -> ' : ' <- ';
          html += '<li><button type=\\'button\\' class=\\'detail-jump\\' data-source=\\'' + escHtml(e.source) +
                  '\\' data-target=\\'' + escHtml(e.target) + '\\'>' + escHtml(d.label) + dir + escHtml(other) +
                  '</button> (' + escHtml(e.evidence) + ')</li>';
        });
        html += '</ul></div>';
      }
      renderDetailPanel(html);
    }

    function showEdgeDetail(edge){
      const d = edge.data();
      let html = '<span class=\\'detail-role\\'>' + escHtml(d.evidence) + '</span>';
      html += '<h4>' + escHtml(d.source) + ' -> ' + escHtml(d.target) + '</h4>';
      html += '<p>' + uniprotLink(d.Uniprot, d.target) + '</p>';
      if(d.Score != null && d.Score !== ''){ html += detailRow('Composite score', Number(d.Score).toFixed(2)); }
      if(d.MotifPercentile != null && d.MotifPercentile !== ''){ html += detailRow('Motif percentile', d.MotifPercentile); }
      if(d.MotifRank != null && d.MotifRank !== ''){ html += detailRow('Kinase rank for site', d.MotifRank); }
      if(d.SharedCompartments != null && d.SharedCompartments !== ''){ html += detailRow('Shared compartments', d.SharedCompartments); }
      if(d.SourceList){ html += detailRow('Sources', d.SourceList); }
      if(d.Reference_PMID){ html += pmidRow(d.Reference_PMID); }

      // Rank candidate sites for the pair: sites where this kinase-site pairing is
      // curated first, then by how well the site fits the kinase motif, then by name.
      const sites = siteData
        .filter(s => s.kinase === d.source && s.substrate === d.target)
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => ((b.evidence === 'Curated') - (a.evidence === 'Curated')) ||
                        ((b.motifPercentile ?? -1) - (a.motifPercentile ?? -1)) ||
                        String(a.site).localeCompare(String(b.site)));
      if(sites.length){
        html += '<div class=\\'detail-sites\\'><strong>Sites</strong><div class=\\'table-scroll\\'><table><thead><tr>' +
          '<th>Site</th><th title=\\'Flanking sequence, -7 to +7\\'>Sequence (+/-7)</th>' +
          '<th class=\\'num\\' title=\\'Site curated in PhosphoSitePlus, EPSD or iPTMnet\\'>Cur.</th>' +
          '<th class=\\'num\\' title=\\'Phosphosite functional score\\'>Func.</th>' +
          '<th class=\\'num\\' title=\\'Motif percentile\\'>Motif</th>' +
          '<th class=\\'num\\' title=\\'Kinase rank for this site\\'>Rank</th>' +
          '<th class=\\'num\\' title=\\'Shared subcellular compartments\\'>Comp.</th>' +
          '</tr></thead><tbody>';
        sites.forEach(s => {
          html += '<tr><td>' + escHtml(s.site) + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + renderFlank(s.flankingSequence) + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + (s.curatedSite ? 'yes' : 'no') + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + escHtml(s.functionalScore) + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + escHtml(s.motifPercentile) + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + escHtml(s.motifRank) + '</td>' +
            '<td class=\\'num\\'>' + escHtml(s.sharedCompartments) + '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '</tbody></table></div></div>';
      }
      renderDetailPanel(html);
    }

    // Node/edge click now opens the detail panel instead of navigating directly
    // to UniProt -- the link is inside the panel instead, so clicking to inspect
    // doesn't cost the user their place in the graph.
    cy.on('tap', 'node', evt => showNodeDetail(evt.target));
    cy.on('tap', 'edge', evt => showEdgeDetail(evt.target));
    cy.on('tap', evt => { if(evt.target === cy){ clearDetailPanel(); } });

    // Collapse the controls sidebar to give the canvas the full left side; the canvas is
    // re-measured and re-fitted because its container width changes.
    const FIT_PADDING = 30;
    document.getElementById('btnControls').addEventListener('click', evt => {
      const hidden = document.querySelector('.app-grid').classList.toggle('controls-hidden');
      evt.currentTarget.textContent = hidden ? 'Show controls' : 'Hide controls';
      cy.resize();
      cy.fit(undefined, FIT_PADDING);
    });

    const detailBodyEl = document.getElementById('detailBody');
    if(detailBodyEl){
      detailBodyEl.addEventListener('click', evt => {
        const btn = evt.target.closest('.detail-jump');
        if(!btn) return;
        const src = btn.getAttribute('data-source');
        const tgt = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
        const matches = cy.edges().filter(ele => ele.data('source') === src && ele.data('target') === tgt);
        if(matches.length){
          showEdgeDetail(matches[0]);
          cy.edges().unselect();
          matches[0].select();
        }
      });
    }

    function setEdgeLabels(show){
      cy.style().selector('edge').style('label', show ? 'data(edgeLabel)' : '').update();
    }
    function setArrows(show){
      cy.style().selector('edge').style('target-arrow-shape', show ? 'triangle' : 'none').update();
    }
    function applyNodeSizing(){
      const scale = Number(labelScale.value || 100) / 100;
      if(labelScaleEl){ labelScaleEl.textContent = Math.round(scale * 100) + '%'; }
      cy.batch(() => {
        cy.nodes().forEach(n => {
          const fontSize = Math.max(9, Math.min(18, baseFont * scale));
          const role = n.data('role') || '';
          const isK = role.indexOf('Kinase') >= 0, isS = role.indexOf('Substrate') >= 0;
          // Hexagon and diamond shapes have less usable interior than a rectangle
          // of the same bounding box, so give them extra padding to keep labels
          // clear of the sloped edges.
          const extra = (isK && isS) ? 5 : isK ? 3 : 0;
          const pad = Math.max(7, Math.min(20, basePad * scale)) + extra;
          n.style({ 'font-size': fontSize, 'padding': pad });
        });
      });
    }
    function isFunctionalEdge(e){
      const v = (e.data('Likely_functional') ?? '').trim();
      return v === 'Likely functional';
    }
    function isCuratedEdge(e){
      const v = (e.data('evidence') ?? '').trim();
      return v === 'Curated';
    }
    function applyFilters(doLayout = true){
      const onlyFunctional = document.getElementById('onlyFunctionalChk').checked;
      const curatedOnly    = document.getElementById('curatedOnlyChk')?.checked;
      const scoreMinEl     = document.getElementById('scoreMin');
      const scoreMin       = scoreMinEl ? Number(scoreMinEl.value) / 100 : 0;

      const seedSet = new Set(currentSeeds || []);
      cy.batch(() => {
        cy.edges().forEach(e => {
          // curated edges have no composite score and are never filtered by it
          const s = e.data('Score');
          const passScore = isCuratedEdge(e) || s == null || Number(s) >= scoreMin;
          const keep = passScore &&
                       (!curatedOnly || isCuratedEdge(e)) && (!onlyFunctional || isFunctionalEdge(e));
          e.style('display', keep ? 'element' : 'none');
        });
        cy.nodes().forEach(n => {
          const hasVisibleEdge = n.connectedEdges(':visible').length > 0;
          const isSeed = seedSet.has(n.id());
          const noEdgeFilters = !curatedOnly && !onlyFunctional && scoreMin === 0;
          n.style('display', (noEdgeFilters || hasVisibleEdge || isSeed) ? 'element' : 'none');
        });
      });
      if(doLayout){ relayout(document.getElementById('layoutSel').value); }
    }

    const EDGE_COLUMNS = ['From','To','UniProt','Evidence','Functional Site?','#Sites','Sites',
                          'Motif percentile','Kinase rank for site','Functional score',
                          'Shared compartments','KinaseCanvas score','Sources','Reference_PMID'];

    function edgeRow(e){
      const fmt = v => (v == null || v === '') ? '' : v;
      return [
        e.data('source'),
        e.data('target'),
        fmt(e.data('Uniprot')),
        e.data('evidence'),
        e.data('Likely_functional'),
        e.data('SiteCount'),
        e.data('Sites'),
        fmt(e.data('MotifPercentile')),
        fmt(e.data('MotifRank')),
        fmt(e.data('FunctionalScore')),
        fmt(e.data('SharedCompartments')),
        fmt(e.data('Score')),
        e.data('SourceList') ?? '',
        e.data('Reference_PMID')
      ];
    }

    // UniProt, Motif percentile, Kinase rank, Functional score, Shared
    // compartments, KinaseCanvas score -- rendered in the monospace data font.
    const EDGE_NUMERIC_COLS = [2, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11];

    function refreshEdgesTable(){
      const rows = cy.edges(':visible').map(edgeRow);
      renderFilterableTable('edgesFilters','edgesTable', EDGE_COLUMNS, rows, EDGE_NUMERIC_COLS);
    }

    function renderFilterableTable(filtersId, tableBoxId, headers, rows, numericCols){
      numericCols = numericCols || [];
      const fwrap = document.getElementById(filtersId);
      const box   = document.getElementById(tableBoxId);
      fwrap.innerHTML = '';
      box.innerHTML   = '';

      const filters = headers.map(h => {
        const inp = document.createElement('input');
        inp.type = 'text';
        inp.placeholder = 'Filter ' + h;
        fwrap.appendChild(inp);
        return inp;
      });

      const table = document.createElement('table');
      table.className = 'tbl';
      const thead = document.createElement('thead');
      const trh   = document.createElement('tr');
      headers.forEach(h => { const th = document.createElement('th'); th.textContent = h; trh.appendChild(th); });
      thead.appendChild(trh); table.appendChild(thead);

      const tbody = document.createElement('tbody'); table.appendChild(tbody); box.appendChild(table);

      function passes(row, query){
        for(let i=0;i<query.length;i++){
          const q = query[i];
          if(q && !String(row[i] ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      }
      function draw(){
        const q = filters.map(x => x.value.trim().toLowerCase());
        tbody.innerHTML = '';
        rows.forEach(r => {
          if(!passes(r, q)) return;
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          r.forEach((v, i) => {
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            if(numericCols.indexOf(i) >= 0){ td.className = 'num'; }
            td.textContent = (v ?? '').toString();
            tr.appendChild(td);
          });
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
      }
      filters.forEach(inp => inp.addEventListener('input', draw));
      draw();
    }

    function incidentSubgraph(seeds){
      const nodeIndex = new Map(data.nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
      const validSeeds = seeds.filter(s => nodeIndex.has(s));
      if(!validSeeds.length){
        lastTruncation = {shown: 0, total: 0, hidden: 0};
        return {nodes:[], edges:[]};
      }

      // Pair mode intersects the two seeds instead of taking their union, which is
      // what a user asking whether kinase X hits substrate Y, and where, actually wants.
      const pairMode = document.getElementById('pairModeChk')?.checked;
      const kinSeed = document.getElementById('kinSel').value.trim();
      const subSeed = document.getElementById('subSel').value.trim();
      let edges = (pairMode && kinSeed && subSeed)
        ? data.edges.filter(e => e.source === kinSeed && e.target === subSeed)
        : data.edges.filter(e => validSeeds.includes(e.source) || validSeeds.includes(e.target));
      if(!edges.length){
        // Reset rather than leave a stale banner from a previous, non-empty query --
        // e.g. pair mode finding no direct edge between two otherwise valid seeds.
        lastTruncation = {shown: 0, total: 0, hidden: 0};
        return {nodes:[], edges:[]};
      }

      // Promiscuous kinases have very large neighbourhoods -- CDK1 alone has 629
      // substrates -- and rendering all of them at once produces a hairball that
      // cannot be read. Unless the user asks for everything, show the most strongly
      // supported subset under an explicit, stated ordering: curated interactions
      // first (they carry direct experimental evidence and no composite score), then
      // predicted ones by descending confidence, ties broken alphabetically so the
      // same seed always yields the same view.
      const showAll = document.getElementById('showAllChk')?.checked;
      const total = edges.length;
      let truncated = 0;
      if(!showAll && total > NEIGHBOURHOOD_CAP){
        edges = edges.slice().sort(edgeRankCompare).slice(0, NEIGHBOURHOOD_CAP);
        truncated = total - edges.length;
      }
      lastTruncation = {shown: edges.length, total: total, hidden: truncated};

      const nset = new Set(); edges.forEach(e => { nset.add(e.source); nset.add(e.target); });
      const nodes = Array.from(nset).map(id => ({
        data: nodeIndex.get(id),
        classes: (validSeeds.includes(id) ? (seeds[0]===id ? 'qk' : (seeds[1]===id ? 'qs' : '')) : '')
      }));

      return {nodes: nodes.map(n => ({ data: n.data, classes: n.classes })), edges: edges.map(e => ({ data: e }))};
    }

    function relayout(name){
      const opts = (name==='concentric') ? { name, minNodeSpacing: 20 } :
                   (name==='breadthfirst') ? { name, directed: true, padding: 10 } :
                   (name==='fcose') ? {
                     name,
                     quality: 'default',
                     randomize: true,
                     randomSeed: 42,
                     animate: false,
                     animationDuration: 1000,
                     fit: true,
                     padding: 30,
                     nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels: false,
                     uniformNodeDimensions: false,
                     packComponents: false,
                     tile: true,
                     samplingType: true,
                     sampleSize: 25,
                     nodeSeparation: 90,
                     nodeRepulsion: node => 4500,
                     idealEdgeLength: edge => 80,
                     edgeElasticity: edge => 0.45,
                     nestingFactor: 0.1,
                     numIter: 2500,
                     gravity: 0.25,
                     gravityRangeCompound: 1.5,
                     gravityCompound: 1.0,
                     gravityRange: 3.8,
                     initialEnergyOnIncremental: 0.3
                   } :
                   (name==='cose-bilkent') ? {
                     name,
                     animate: false,
                     quality: 'draft',
                     nodeRepulsion: 30000,
                     idealEdgeLength: 140,
                     gravity: 0.8,
                     tile: true,
                     nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels: true,
                     padding: 30
                   } :
                   { name: 'cose', animate: false };
      cy.layout(opts).run();
    }

    function render(){
      const kin   = document.getElementById('kinSel').value.trim();
      const sub   = document.getElementById('subSel').value.trim();
      const seeds = [kin, sub].filter(s => s && s.length);
      if(!seeds.length) return;

      currentSeeds = seeds;

      const elems = incidentSubgraph(seeds);
      const note = document.getElementById('truncNote');
      if(note){
        const pairMode = document.getElementById('pairModeChk')?.checked;
        note.textContent = lastTruncation.hidden > 0
          ? 'Showing the ' + lastTruncation.shown + ' best-supported of ' +
            lastTruncation.total + ' interactions (curated first, then by confidence). ' +
            lastTruncation.hidden + ' hidden. Tick Show all substrates to include them.'
          : (pairMode && elems.edges.length === 0)
            ? 'No interaction between these two in the resource.'
            : '';
      }
      cy.elements().remove();
      cy.add(elems.nodes);
      cy.add(elems.edges);
      applyNodeSizing();
      applyFilters(true);
      refreshEdgesTable();
    }

    const triggerRender = () => render();
    const triggerOnEnter = el => el.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if(e.key === 'Enter') render(); });
    kinInput.addEventListener('change', triggerRender);
    subInput.addEventListener('change', triggerRender);
    triggerOnEnter(kinInput);
    triggerOnEnter(subInput);
    document.getElementById('layoutSel').addEventListener('change', () => render());
    document.getElementById('edgeLabelsChk').addEventListener('change', e => setEdgeLabels(e.target.checked));
    document.getElementById('arrowsChk').addEventListener('change', e => setArrows(e.target.checked));
    document.getElementById('onlyFunctionalChk').addEventListener('change', () => {
      applyFilters(true);
      refreshEdgesTable();
    });
    const scoreMinEl = document.getElementById('scoreMin');
    if(scoreMinEl){
      scoreMinEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
        document.getElementById('scoreMinVal').textContent =
          (Number(scoreMinEl.value) / 100).toFixed(2);
        applyFilters(false);
        refreshEdgesTable();
      });
    }
    const pairModeEl = document.getElementById('pairModeChk');
    if(pairModeEl){ pairModeEl.addEventListener('change', () => render()); }
    const showAllEl = document.getElementById('showAllChk');
    if(showAllEl){ showAllEl.addEventListener('change', () => render()); }

    document.getElementById('curatedOnlyChk').addEventListener('change', () => {
      applyFilters(true);
      refreshEdgesTable();
    });
    labelScale.addEventListener('input', applyNodeSizing);

    function download(filename, blob){
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 5000);
    }
    function csvBlob(rows, header){
      const esc = v => '\"' + String(v ?? '').replaceAll('\"','\"\"') + '\"';
      const lines = [header.map(esc).join(',')].concat(rows.map(r => r.map(esc).join(',')));
      const newline = String.fromCharCode(10);
      const csv = lines.join(newline);
      return new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv'});
    }
    document.getElementById('btnPng').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const uri = cy.png({full:true, scale:2});
      fetch(uri).then(r => r.blob()).then(b => download('kinome_network.png', b));
    });
    document.getElementById('btnPdf').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const uri = cy.png({full:true, scale:2});
      fetch(uri).then(r => r.blob()).then(b => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(){
          const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
          const pdf  = new jsPDF({orientation:'landscape', unit:'pt', format:'a4'});
          const img  = reader.result;
          const pageW = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
          const pageH = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
          pdf.addImage(img, 'PNG', 20, 20, pageW-40, pageH-40);
          pdf.save('kinome_network.pdf');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(b);
      });
    });
    document.getElementById('btnCsvEdges').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const rows = cy.edges(':visible').map(edgeRow);
      download('kinome_edges.csv', csvBlob(rows, EDGE_COLUMNS));
    });

    document.getElementById('btnFullNetwork').addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Export every edge in the network, not just the visible subgraph.
      const fmt = v => (v == null || v === '') ? '' : v;
      const rows = data.edges.map(e => [
        e.source, e.target, fmt(e.Uniprot), e.evidence, e.Likely_functional,
        e.SiteCount, e.Sites, fmt(e.MotifPercentile), fmt(e.MotifRank),
        fmt(e.FunctionalScore), fmt(e.SharedCompartments), fmt(e.Score),
        e.SourceList ?? '', e.Reference_PMID
      ]);
      download('kinome_full_network.csv', csvBlob(rows, EDGE_COLUMNS));
    });

    // Site-level export: one row per kinase-substrate-site triad, with the
    // individual evidence values behind each classification.
    const SITE_COLUMNS = ['Kinase','Substrate','UniProt','Site','Sequence (+/-7)','Evidence',
                          'Curated site','Likely functional','Motif percentile',
                          'Kinase rank for site','Functional score','Shared compartments',
                          'KinaseCanvas score'];
    const siteBtn = document.getElementById('btnCsvSites');
    if(siteBtn){
      siteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const fmt = v => (v == null || v === '') ? '' : v;
        const visible = new Set(cy.edges(':visible').map(e => e.data('source') + '||' + e.data('target')));
        const subset = siteData.filter(s => visible.has(s.kinase + '||' + s.substrate));
        const rows = (subset.length ? subset : siteData).map(s => [
          s.kinase, s.substrate, fmt(s.uniprot), s.site, fmt(s.flankingSequence), s.evidence,
          s.curatedSite, s.likelyFunctional, fmt(s.motifPercentile), fmt(s.motifRank),
          fmt(s.functionalScore), fmt(s.sharedCompartments), fmt(s.score)
        ]);
        download(subset.length ? 'kinasecanvas_sites_selection.csv'
                               : 'kinasecanvas_sites_all.csv',
                 csvBlob(rows, SITE_COLUMNS));
      });
    }

    setEdgeLabels(false);
    setArrows(true);
    applyNodeSizing();
    render();
  })();
  "))
)

browsable(tagList(data_tags, viewer_tags))
```
